Subject: Decision Passport: MAP & Acceptance Tests for MedSync Evaluation

Hi Lara / Tom,

Thanks again for the time this morning. Attached is a compact "Decision Passport" — a one-page mutual action plan that ties the evaluation milestones to explicit acceptance tests and the proposed close timeline. My goal: make the go/no-go decision objective and fast for both teams.

High-level sprint (3 weeks)
- Week 1 (Integration & smoke): SDK + VPC auth, baseline traffic, sanity tests
- Week 2 (Quality & perf): test corpus runs, latency/throughput ramps, concordance checks
- Week 3 (Stability & signoff): production-like soak, export of logs + compliance artifacts, final decision meeting

Acceptance tests (pass criteria) — must all be met for "GO":
1) Latency: p99 inference for 512-token inputs < 200ms over a 1-hour sustained run at expected concurrency.
2) Accuracy: embedding recall >= 0.85 on MedSync validation set (top-5 retrieval).
3) Throughput: sustained 30 concurrent active sessions for 2 hours without queue growth or dropped requests.
4) Security & privacy: audit of 500 request samples shows no PII leakage, and KMS-based keys rotate successfully in the VPC deployment.
5) Integration: full SDK call path (auth, upload prompt, receive streaming tokens) works end-to-end from MedSync staging environment.

Exit gates (fail fast)
- Critical: repeated p99 > 350ms despite transient retries and batch tuning -> Requires escalation.
- Critical: embedding recall < 0.7 -> stop and pivot to model/param change.
- Blocker: inability to complete VPC peering or missing KMS integration -> evaluation paused until resolved.

Required artifacts for signoff
- Performance report (p50/p95/p99 distributions), token cost estimate at observed throughput
- Sample inference logs (anonymized) + concordance analysis vs. golden set
- Security checklist & evidence (KMS key ARN, peering confirmation, SOC2 ask status)
- Mutually signed close decision note (DocuSign link)

Files attached: decision-passport-v1.pdf (one-pager), mvp-test-cases.xlsx (detailed test matrix).

Next steps
- We propose kickoff on Tue 2/10 and a final decision meeting Thu 2/26. If that works for you, we'll schedule the invite and loop in engineering hours.

Thanks,
Dylan
